deck: THEY TEST NICHES, STRICT MAP POLICIES, AND MULTI-TOUCH SUPPLIER OUTREACH
THEY BUILD AUTHORIZED-DEALER STORES ON GOOGLE SHOPPING AT 15-30% MARGINS
site_ui.lead: Practitioners show how authorized-dealer stores list $1,000-plus products from established US brands, collect the customer's money first, and let the supplier ship within days, from opening supplier accounts through conversion and scaling to eight figures.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies into one operating playbook for automated e-commerce. Every claim, metric, and quote carries timestamped inline attribution to the practitioner and video it came from.
chapters: The High-Ticket Dropshipping Model: Niches, Products, and Real Store Results
Opening Supplier Accounts: High-Ticket Brands and Amazon Wholesale Distributors
Landed Cost: Duties, Tariffs, and the True Cost of Goods
Cash Conversion Cycle and Working Capital
Sales Tax Nexus and Compliance Automation
Automating the Back Office, and the Automation Traps
Google Shopping Feeds and Merchant Center
Conversion and Scaling to Eight Figures
flow: Confirm demand with WordStream or Semrush, keep evergreen trends, drop anything seasonal or under $1,000, and skip products sold by Best Buy, Home Depot, Lowe's or Walmart
Search 'buy [brand] [product]' in the Shopping tab, count thriving online-only dealers through Similarweb math, and confirm strict MAP on identical models
Register a real business and apply to 10-20 brands at once for 30-50% acceptance, following up on day 1, day 4, a call on day 8, LinkedIn on day 12, and a final email on day 18
Check address, About Us, social media, Trustpilot and BBB, and reject $5,000-plus minimums, drop-ship fees over $15 per order, or margin under 10 to 15 percent
Price chargeback, return and warranty exposure into each brand's margin, then run bottom-of-funnel Google Shopping with Meta pushed to remarketing
Collect the customer's money first, email the supplier the order, let them ship within days, and keep adding brands so no single supplier dominates revenue

tagline: Big Money. Small Teams. No Bullshit.
title: AUTOMATED E-COMMERCE
subtitle: Authorized-dealer dropshipping on $1,000-plus US brands, supplier accounts won by persistent outreach, contribution margin before CAC, landed cost beyond the invoice, a shorter cash cycle, register-first sales tax, tested 3PLs, scam-proof automation, budgeted returns, AI support with human refund gates, feed-first Google Shopping, and scaling on CAC payback
